name: Aggramar
shortDescription: The titan who discovered the imperiled world of Azeroth and urged the Pantheon to act through purpose-built servants rather than overwhelming force.
body: Aggramar recognized both the promise of Azeroth's sleeping world-soul and the danger posed by the Black Empire. Blizzard's first-party account emphasizes his concern that the Pantheon's colossal intervention could destroy what they meant to save.
